data_basis: placeholder — approximate dominant soil texture per district, stand-in for the live satellite/soil-sensor data described in CLAUDE.md
source_note: Compiled from public Punjab soil-classification references (Dept. of Soil & Water Conservation Punjab; Punjab PCS geography notes): south-western districts are dominated by calcareous/desert (sandy) soils, central Punjab ranges sandy loam to clay loam, and the sub-mountainous north-east tends toward loam to clay.
